2024.ST5.1.t: Council Member Appointments to the City of Toronto Long-Term Care Committee of Management
2024.ST5.1.s: The purpose of this report is to recommend to City Council the appointment of Council Members to the City of Toronto Long-Term Care Committee of Management.
2024.ST5.1.r:
The City Clerk recommends that:

1. The Striking Committee consider Members' preferences and eligibility and recommend to City Council the appointment of a Council Member to the City of Toronto Long-Term Care Committee of Management for a term of office until November 14, 2026, and until a successor is appointed.
